# coralogix_saved_heatmap (Data Source)



## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    coralogix = {
      source = "coralogix/coralogix"
    }
  }
}

data "coralogix_saved_heatmap" "example" {
  id = "<id>"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Heatmap ID, a decimal number. Set by the server.

### Read-Only

- `action_name_filter` (String) Which clicks the heatmap includes.
- `app_name` (String) RUM application the heatmap belongs to.
- `created_at` (String) When the heatmap was created. Set by the server.
- `filters` (Attributes Set) Session filters of the heatmap. Empty when not set. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--filters))
- `mode` (String) Kind of heatmap visualization shown for the page view.
- `name` (String) Display name of the heatmap. Does not have to be unique.
- `owner` (String) User who created the heatmap. Set by the server. Absent for heatmaps saved before owners were recorded.
- `snapshot_id` (String) ID of the page snapshot the heatmap is drawn on. Absent when the heatmap has no snapshot.
- `time_range` (Attributes) Time range of the heatmap. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--time_range))
- `updated_at` (String) When the heatmap was last updated, from the API or the Coralogix UI. Set by the server.
- `version` (Number) Version of the heatmap. Set by the server: 1 on create, increased by 1 on every update, including updates made in the Coralogix UI.
- `view_name` (String) Name of the page view the heatmap covers.

<a id="nestedatt--filters"></a>
### Nested Schema for `filters`

Read-Only:

- `bool_filter` (Attributes) A boolean field with the value it must have. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--filters--bool_filter))
- `numeric_filter` (Attributes) A numeric field with the condition it must match. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--filters--numeric_filter))
- `string_filter` (Attributes) A string field with the condition it must match. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--filters--string_filter))

<a id="nestedatt--filters--bool_filter"></a>
### Nested Schema for `filters.bool_filter`

Read-Only:

- `field` (String) Boolean field to filter on. BOOL_FILTER_FIELD_UNSPECIFIED is rejected.
- `value` (Boolean) Value the field must have.


<a id="nestedatt--filters--numeric_filter"></a>
### Nested Schema for `filters.numeric_filter`

Read-Only:

- `condition` (Attributes) Condition the field must match. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--filters--numeric_filter--condition))
- `field` (String) Numeric field to filter on. NUMERIC_FILTER_FIELD_UNSPECIFIED is rejected.

<a id="nestedatt--filters--numeric_filter--condition"></a>
### Nested Schema for `filters.numeric_filter.condition`

Read-Only:

- `max` (String) Matches values less than or equal to max.
- `min` (String) Matches values greater than or equal to min.
- `range` (Attributes) Matches values from lower to upper, both included. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--filters--numeric_filter--condition--range))

<a id="nestedatt--filters--numeric_filter--condition--range"></a>
### Nested Schema for `filters.numeric_filter.condition.range`

Read-Only:

- `lower` (String) Lowest matching value, included. Must not be greater than upper.
- `upper` (String) Highest matching value, included.




<a id="nestedatt--filters--string_filter"></a>
### Nested Schema for `filters.string_filter`

Read-Only:

- `condition` (Attributes) Condition the field must match. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--filters--string_filter--condition))
- `field` (String) String field to filter on. STRING_FILTER_FIELD_UNSPECIFIED is rejected.

<a id="nestedatt--filters--string_filter--condition"></a>
### Nested Schema for `filters.string_filter.condition`

Read-Only:

- `operator` (String) Matching operator. STRING_CONDITION_OPERATOR_UNSPECIFIED is rejected.
- `values` (Set of String) Values to match. At least one is required.




<a id="nestedatt--time_range"></a>
### Nested Schema for `time_range`

Read-Only:

- `calendar` (String) Named calendar window, resolved in the viewer's timezone. CALENDAR_WINDOW_UNSPECIFIED is rejected.
- `fixed` (Attributes) Absolute time range between two timestamps. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--time_range--fixed))
- `relative_minutes` (String) Number of minutes back from now.

<a id="nestedatt--time_range--fixed"></a>
### Nested Schema for `time_range.fixed`

Read-Only:

- `from_timestamp_ms` (String) Start of the range, in Unix milliseconds. Inclusive: events at exactly this time are in the range.
- `to_timestamp_ms` (String) End of the range, in Unix milliseconds. Exclusive: events at exactly this time are not in the range, so consecutive ranges can share a boundary.
